record.file_problem: Repository README and file list only; notebook code was not read or run. The README says executed notebook outputs were not preserved, and it provides no reproducible numerical results.
record.tranche_reason: The README describes a difference-of-means direction and residual-stream direction ablation, following the original workflow, and reports qualitative outcomes on Gemma-2-2b-it. The results are exploratory and not numerically reproducible from the repository text.
record.gate_note: The README reports qualitative response changes after ablation but no exact rates or values. It also says the retained figures do not preserve exact numerical claims. The v2 notebook is described as a reproducible-evaluation workflow, but no v2 results are reported. Direction norms and other visualization outputs are exploratory measurements, not separate outcome rows here.
record.test_reason: It runs the original recipe on Gemma-2-2b-it: a difference-in-means direction with residual-stream projection removal. Ablation is one layer at a time. The README reports only that responses changed in some qualitative examples. It gives no refusal rate, so it attempts a T1 test but yields no readable result on V1.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly correct. The authors call v1 an exploratory prototype with preliminary qualitative evidence that ablating selected directions can change refusal, consistent with a low-dimensional component. They say it does not establish a held-out refusal-rate change, that the vector is refusal rather than a correlated feature, capability costs, or transfer. Notebook outputs were not preserved.
record.recipe_differences: Exploratory replication-style project: it uses a harmful-minus-harmless difference of means and residual-stream projection removal, but estimates directions from last-token hidden states and intervenes one layer at a time rather than reporting an all-layer ablation. The README also describes a v2 notebook, but reports no v2 results.
record.method_sensitivity: The README says selected layers or directions appeared more sensitive to ablation; it gives no layer-specific numerical outcomes.
record.problems: Notebook outputs are not preserved, so exact numerical claims cannot be checked from the README. The README describes a small prompt set, manual pairing, no held-out estimate, a keyword-based refusal detector, no capability measurement, and no controls in the reported v1 results.
record.rows_left_out: No separate outcomes were reported for individual layers or metrics in the README; the figures are described only as qualitative artifacts, without layer-specific values in the text. The v2 notebook is listed but has no reported results.

untested.parts: Ablation at all layers at once, adding the direction to induce refusal, capability retention, benign over-refusal, held-out evaluation and controls. A readable refusal-rate change is also not reported.

missing.what: A layer-by-layer refusal-rate curve after ablation is shown only as an image. No values appear in the text; it would be needed to judge V1 if it can be read.

record.verdict_notes: The reader's limits_scope label is dropped. It rested on parts the study did not test, which belong under untested, and r1's value cannot be read as partial. No v2 results are reported. The source is a student README with no numbers, so its evidential weight is minimal.

versions.untested_parts: The README describes one-layer-at-a-time ablation, not simultaneous ablation at every layer. It does not report direction addition, establish that refusal was removed, or measure retention of general capability.
No weight edit or abliteration result is reported.
No attack suppression of the direction or training against its ablation is reported.
No comparison of a single direction with an affine, cone, or multiple-direction account is reported.
No separate measurement of harmfulness judgment and refusal decision is reported.
No cross-language, cross-model-variant, or base-to-instruct transfer result is reported.
No comparison of refusal-training methods or training stages is reported.

rows.subject: google/gemma-2-2b-it
rows.operation_detail: Remove the projection onto a layer-wise harmful-minus-harmless difference-of-means direction with a forward hook; ablate one Transformer layer at a time.

conditions.value: 50 harmful prompts, paired in the direction-estimation set with 50 harmless prompts
Sweep across 26 Transformer layers, one layer at a time
Qualitative generation comparison; v1 initial evaluator was a refusal-keyword heuristic

rows.measure: Qualitative change in refusal behavior / generated response after ablation
rows.value: The README reports qualitative examples in which responses changed after ablation; it gives no numerical refusal-rate change or specific refusal-to-compliance result.
rows.note: The README says selected directions or layers appeared more sensitive, but does not report per-layer outcomes or preserve exact numerical claims. It explicitly says held-out evaluation and capability-degradation or benign over-refusal measurements are not established.
rows.check: The value is only 'response changed after ablation' in unspecified examples. There is no baseline, no refusal rate and no statement that refusal was removed, so the effect's size or direction can't be read. 'Partial' overstates what is reported. The README also says exact numbers from the run should not be cited.

source_check.scope: Only the listed rows, labels and statements were checked; presence is not whole-study approval.
